info.description: THAI Please auth, wallet, QR payments, frozen Coin rates and monthly Main Quest reward contracts. Recommendation candidates now require the GET /stores coordinate/radius scope; AI /chat accepts location for shop reads. Configure recommendationLatitude/Longitude/RadiusKm. Description relevance: /chat reads scoped GET /stores and evaluates direct/plausible descriptions before 3+2 quotas; candidates accepts optional narrowing shopIds (0-200).
